The frozen facts-counted-g10017 policy retains its earlier V100 acceptance at source 6c6633220b67faffa0f01a5fa5c4f7a556a97f0b. The preparation-only audit verified 4864 artifacts, 86 GPU tests with zero skips, both exact GPU training-resume acceptances, four selected/resume/test lineages, and the complete post-build source digest including nine generated CMake files. All 1200 planned formal match games completed in jobs 2349386 and 2349387 (both COMPLETED, exit 0:0), at the same frozen source. The final strict audit passed 6054 artifact checks and recomputed all six seed-specific comparisons and three fixed-seed pooled intervals. Recovery reused 95 verified preparation files and transferred 1341 additional files; all 1436 final member files were verified. The original full remote tar archive was not downloaded or hashed locally. The incremental transfer archive hash matches its remote digest. Every comparison remains statistically inconclusive; facts-counted-g10017 remains the default.

evaluation_limitations: The original 1200-game evaluation cohort participated in selecting pi0 and is not held-out evidence for that selection.
The prior 2026-10-03 facts joint experiment uses one training seed and one 100-layout-pair cohort; both score and win-rate intervals include 0.5.
The prior 2026-10-03 formal candidate combines the same frozen policy, trained belief module and search; this comparison does not isolate neural-belief effects from search effects.
The prior 2026-10-03 held-out test NLL and accuracy are teacher-forced conditional identity metrics, not marginal identity accuracy or gameplay strength.
Intervals are not adjusted for multiple comparisons.

The matched 2026-10-04 experiment uses two trained belief seeds but one frozen policy seed. Pooled intervals condition on those fixed trained belief seeds and do not estimate training-seed-population uncertainty.
The three matchups share layouts within each belief seed; their results are correlated, and six seed-specific intervals plus three pooled intervals are not nine independent discoveries.
The 1200-game matched experiment uses 200 distinct layouts across two seeds, each reused for all three matchups with swapped teams.
Matched marginal NLL is public-only per-piece prediction; joint NLL is teacher-forced conditional prediction. Their numerical values are not directly comparable.
Marginal-vs-pi0 and joint-vs-pi0 measure the complete belief-plus-search system. Joint-vs-marginal compares the two learned conditioning designs under the same frozen search budget.
